understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through each KA59 level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; once a level reports WIN, continue until the final level is cleared.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each action moves the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction unless blocked by walls/boundaries or other objects; some adjacent objects are pushable blocks that can be pushed along with the selected piece if space allows. Levels may contain multiple selectable pieces, and control can be switched by using CLICK on the other selectable's exact pixel coordinate shown in the state. The movement_*_blocked flags are only hints about adjacent objects and don't guarantee the move will fail.

understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through each KA59 level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; once a level reports WIN, continue until the final level is cleared.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each action moves the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction unless blocked by walls/boundaries or other objects; some adjacent objects are pushable blocks that can be pushed along with the selected piece if space allows. Levels may contain multiple selectable pieces, and control can be switched by using CLICK on the other selectable's exact pixel coordinate shown in the state. The movement_*_blocked flags are only hints about adjacent objects and don't guarantee the move will fail.
